business_problem: Bespin needed to industrialize enterprise AI agents without forcing customers to stitch together model stacks, orchestration frameworks, and multimodal data pipelines by hand. It also needed better document understanding for Word, PDF, image, and Excel inputs and a faster way to import proprietary enterprise knowledge into production agents.
solution_summary: Bespin Global built its ChatOmni enterprise agent platform on Alibaba Cloud Bailian so it could package model access, evaluation, multimodal parsing, and RAG into one delivery stack. Bailian provides the model-training, deployment, knowledge-base, and moderation services, while Qwen-VL and Qwen text models handle image and document understanding for Word, PDF, image, and Excel inputs. Parsed content flows into a vectorized RAG layer that turns dispersed enterprise material into reusable knowledge, then ChatOmni wraps those services with customer-specific business logic and open-source orchestration using LangChain and CrewAI. Prompt-engineering utilities and review controls improve answer quality before responses reach end users. This lets Bespin ship document-factory workflows and enterprise knowledge assistants as configurable products instead of one-off integrations.

solution_components.name: ChatOmni
solution_components.role: Packages Bespin's customer-facing agent applications, document workflows, and knowledge services into a configurable enterprise platform.

solution_components.name: Alibaba Cloud Bailian
solution_components.role: Provides the model training, deployment, evaluation, knowledge-base, RAG, prompt, and moderation services that underpin ChatOmni.

solution_components.name: Qwen-VL
solution_components.role: Handles multimodal image and document understanding for files that need visual parsing.

solution_components.name: Qwen large models
solution_components.role: Generate answers, reasoning steps, and enterprise-agent outputs on top of the parsed and retrieved content.

solution_components.name: LangChain
solution_components.role: Coordinates higher-level agent logic and custom workflow assembly above the model layer.

solution_components.name: CrewAI
solution_components.role: Supports the multi-agent collaboration patterns Bespin uses in customer-specific deployments.

data_flow: Word, PDF, image, and Excel files enter Bailian's OCR and parsing pipeline, where Qwen-VL and Qwen extract and normalize content. The processed material is vectorized into a RAG knowledge base, then ChatOmni uses LangChain and CrewAI orchestration, prompt templates, and review controls to generate answers, document outputs, or agent actions for enterprise users.
business_outcome: Bespin expanded supported corpora to more than 20 file types, increased image-parsing precision from 55% to 85%, improved overall accuracy by 50%, and reduced a typical multi-agent delivery cycle from about one day to roughly two hours, lifting overall service efficiency by 70%.
metrics: image parsing precision increased from 55% to 85%
delivery cycle reduced from 1 day to about 2 hours

Multimodal document understanding uses OCR, document parsing, Qwen-VL, and Qwen text models together.
Enterprise knowledge is vectorized into a Bailian-backed RAG layer before agents answer questions.
Prompt-engineering and content-review controls are embedded in the delivery stack to improve quality and compliance.
